nodes.description: Address of the contract owner; controls privileged functions lock, unlock, own and releaseFunds.
Boolean lock flag guarding the bet payout path against repeated withdrawals.
Payable bet function that checks randomness, msg.value and locked flag, then sends 2 ether to the caller.
Owner-only function that sets locked = true.
Owner-only function that sets locked = false.
Ownership transfer function allowing first caller or current owner to set gameOwner.
Owner-only function that transfers amount * 1 ether to msg.sender.
View pseudo-random generator based on block.timestamp and block.difficulty.
Payable fallback function that forwards all plain calls to bet().
Caller-controlled address used as bet participant, access-control check value and transfer recipient.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as entropy for the random() function.
msg.sender.call.value(2 ether)() low-level external call performed before state is finalized, enabling reentrancy.
msg.sender.transfer(amount * (1 ether)) multiplication and transfer of user-supplied amount.
Parameter of own(address owner) used to set the gameOwner state variable.
Parameter of releaseFunds(uint amount) used in the payout arithmetic.

edges.reason: Fallback function forwards plain payable calls directly into bet(), exposing bet to external callers.
msg.sender triggers the fallback function which re-enters bet().
msg.sender is the caller whose address is used as the payout recipient inside bet().
locked state variable gates the bet payout branch but does not prevent reentrant calls.
Randomness result from random() is consumed by the bet() win condition.
block.timestamp feeds the pseudo-random generator, creating miner-influenced dependency.
msg.sender is the target of the low-level call.value(2 ether)() external call.
bet() executes the external value call that can re-enter the contract.
External call to msg.sender can call back into bet() through the fallback before state updates.
gameOwner is compared against msg.sender to authorize lock().
msg.sender is the value checked for ownership authorization in lock().
lock() writes true into the locked state variable.
gameOwner is compared against msg.sender to authorize unlock().
msg.sender is the value checked for ownership authorization in unlock().
unlock() writes false into the locked state variable.
gameOwner comparison in own() allows first caller or current owner to seize ownership.
msg.sender is compared to gameOwner to authorize ownership transfer in own().
owner parameter is assigned to the gameOwner state variable.
gameOwner is compared against msg.sender to authorize releaseFunds().
msg.sender is the value checked for ownership authorization in releaseFunds().
amount parameter is multiplied by 1 ether inside the transfer expression.
releaseFunds() performs the transfer of amount * 1 ether to the caller.
msg.sender is the recipient of the transfer in releaseFunds().

normalization_plan.reason: owner is a parameter used only inside own() to set the gameOwner state variable, so it collapses into the own function node.
amount is a parameter used only inside releaseFunds() for the payout arithmetic, so it collapses into the releaseFunds function node.
